The visible frames of snapped windows tile the work area exactly: no gap from the invisible borders, no pixel lost on odd sizes. Coordinates are physical virtual-screen pixels (negative left of or above the primary monitor) of the visible frame (find_windows' visibleBounds, not its bounds). A minimized or maximized window is restored to normal first, without activating it; one its app hid (in the notification area) is not shown, and the change fails. InvalidMonitorIndex: monitorIndex is not a monitor (error gives the valid range). MoveFailed: Windows did not place it, or it did not return to normal from minimized or maximized.

delayBetweenMs.description: Delay between operations in milliseconds (0-5000, default: 50)

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.title: Capture Monitor
tools.description: Capture a specific monitor. Returns the image as image content you can see, followed by JSON metadata (size, capturedRegion, imageToScreen, filePath). By default the image is JPEG (PNG when its long edge is at most 512 pixels) scaled to at most 1568 pixels on the long edge. Image pixels are not screen pixels: to click a point (imageX, imageY) seen in the image, use screenX = imageToScreen.offsetX + imageX * imageToScreen.scaleX and screenY = imageToScreen.offsetY + imageY * imageToScreen.scaleY. scaleFactor is the monitor's DPI scale, for information only; never multiply by it. Use list_screens to get available monitor indices.

monitorIndex.description: Monitor index to capture (0-based). Use list_screens to see available monitors. Defaults to primary monitor.

format.description: Image format: 'auto' (default: JPEG, or PNG when the image's long edge is at most 512 pixels), 'png' (lossless, larger) or 'jpeg' ('jpg' is accepted too). With outputPath, 'auto' follows the file extension. Any other value is rejected with InvalidFormat.

quality.description: JPEG quality (1-100). Only used for JPEG. Default: 80

maxDimension.description: Longest edge of the image in pixels; larger captures are scaled down proportionally. Default (null): 1568, the size vision models work at. 0 keeps full resolution. imageToScreen reports the resulting scale.

output.description: What to return: 'image' (default: the image and the metadata), 'file' (write the image to a file and return only the metadata with filePath), 'both' (image, file and metadata) or 'metadata' (only the metadata, no image). Any other value is rejected with InvalidOutputMode.

outputPath.description: Absolute path on a drive letter (no network or device paths) of the image file for output 'file' or 'both', ending in .png, .jpg or .jpeg to match the format. The folder must exist; it is not created. Default: a new file in %TEMP%\WindowsAppManagerMcp\captures.

overwrite.description: Allow outputPath to replace an existing file. Default: false, which reports an existing file as FileExists.

saveToFile.description: Deprecated alias for output 'file': true writes the image to a file and returns only the metadata. Default: false

maxWidth.description: Deprecated: maximum image width in pixels. Given without maxDimension it replaces the 1568 default and limits only the width; with maxDimension both limits apply.

window.description: Alternative to windowHandle: a window selector with find_windows' filters (processName is the whole name; plus foreground, index), resolved to exactly one window and then used as windowHandle. {"foreground": true} alone counts as no windowHandle, and allowHostTarget needs the window named by handle. A window that no longer matches the selector once the call's turn comes (another document or tab) gets nothing (HandleMismatch).

allowHostTarget.description: Allow input to the agent's own host window: the terminal, editor or chat app this server was started from. Works only together with windowHandle (or window.handle) naming that window; set it only when the user explicitly asked for input there. Default: false

releaseHeldModifiers.description: Release modifier keys (Shift, Ctrl, Alt, Windows) that are down before the input is sent, instead of refusing with ModifiersHeld. Set it only when nobody is pressing them (a stuck key) or the user asked. Nothing is released while a modifier of the user's pause hotkey is down. Default: false
